description: This file contains classes and functions related to managing dashboard connections, tab control, and Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) sessions within the Playwright testing framework. It includes classes for DashboardConnection and CDPConnection, handling browser context interactions, event management, and communication with browser devtools.

classes.name: DashboardConnection
classes.description: Manages a dashboard connection, handling browser context, page events, and communication with the dashboard UI.

classes.name: CDPConnection
classes.description: Handles a Chrome DevTools Protocol session for a specific page, enabling sending and receiving CDP commands.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for a specific dashboard channel event.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes an event listener for a specific dashboard channel event.

methods.name: _emit
methods.description: Emits an event to send to the dashboard and invoke registered listeners.

methods.name: onconnect
methods.description: Initializes the dashboard connection.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Sets up the browser context, event listeners, and initial state.

methods.name: onclose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and closes the connection.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a method call to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by pageId.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a tab by pageId.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the selected page to a specified URL.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back in the selected page.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Navigates forward in the selected page.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the selected page.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Simulates mouse move.

methods.name: mousedown
methods.description: Simulates mouse button down.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Simulates mouse button up.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Simulates mouse wheel scroll.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Simulates key down.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Simulates key up.

methods.name: _selectPage
methods.description: Selects a page and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: _deselectPage
methods.description: Deselects the current page and cleans up.

methods.name: pickLocator
methods.description: Initiates element locator picking.

methods.name: cancelPickLocator
methods.description: Cancels element locator picking.

methods.name: _sendCachedState
methods.description: Sends cached frame and tab list state.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns list of open tabs.

methods.name: _tabList
methods.description: Generates list of tab info objects.

methods.name: pageForId
methods.description: Finds a page by pageId.

methods.name: _pageId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for a page.

methods.name: _devtoolsUrl
methods.description: Constructs devtools URL for a page.

methods.name: _pageInspectorUrl
methods.description: Constructs inspector URL for a page.

methods.name: _sendTabList
methods.description: Emits the current tab list.

methods.name: _writeFrame
methods.description: Stores and emits a new frame of screencast data.

methods.name: getBrowserRevision
methods.description: Retrieves the browser revision string via CDP.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Sends a CDP command via the session.

methods.name: _initializeRawSession
methods.description: Creates a new CDP session for a page.
